environments: native — the only profile: spring.profiles.active: native at application.yml:21-22; runtime-confirmed by logs/config-service.log:2

'native' selects the CLASSPATH backend: documents are read from the packaged config/ directory inside this jar (default classpath:/config/, not overridden here), so platform configuration is versioned inside this repository and shipped in the config-service jar — no git remote is contacted at boot; changing it means rebuilding/redeploying config-service (or writing file:./config/) plus a restart or /refresh

Resolve jwt.token.validity: 180000 vs its '#3 minutes validity' comment (180000 ms = 3 hours) — an auth-policy discrepancy in the file that sets it.
